Til Death Do Us Unite
is the eighth studio album by German
thrash metal
band
Sodom
.
[
1
]
It was released on 24 February 1997 by
Steamhammer
/
SPV
. It is the first Sodom album with guitarist Bernermann and drummer Bobby Schottkowski.
A video was made for the song "Fuck the Police".
